messages:
Marta C: heads up — RidgeView (enterprise) requested temporary rate window increase + US‑GOV region allowlist for a pilot next week. Need ops + infra help.
Marta C: Customer details: ridgeview.ai, pilot with VA partners, gov-only endpoints.
Marta C: Ask: increase per-minute requests from 300 → 1200 for 48 hours, add allowlist for region us-gov-west-1 and IP ranges 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25, and route traffic to the us-gov cluster.
Sam T: @Marta C noted. Do we want a burst window or a permanent quota change?
Marta C: temporary burst only. Start Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC, end Wed 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC. Customer signed NDA and completed gov onboarding checklist.
Jia L: infra note — us-gov cluster exists. Allowlist + firewall rules + route policy needs to be pushed. I can do this if we have sign-off by EOD Friday.
Tom R: Security: have they requested any special egress rules or KMS usage?
Marta C: they want KMS in private mode + extra egress logging retention for audit.
Tom R: KMS attach OK. Will update logging retention and add to ticket.
Marta C: ops config (paste for RDW team):
```json
{
  "customer": "ridgeview",
  "rate_limit": {"window": "minute", "limit": 1200, "start": "2026-04-06T09:00:00Z", "end": "2026-04-08T09:00:00Z"},
  "allowlist": {"region": "us-gov-west-1", "cidrs": ["198.51.100.0/24", "203.0.113.128/25"]},
  "routing": "us-gov-cluster-3",
  "notes": "pilot - gov demo; billing alert on >70% utilization"
}
```
Sam T: LGTM. I'll create the temporary SLA exception and configure the billing/usage alert.
Deploy Bot: deploy request created: RDW-4567, assigned to Jia L — https://redwood.internal/ops/RDW-4567 :gear:
Jia L: starting infra changes tomorrow 2026-03-27. Allowlist push ETA ~6 hours once I begin. I'll post step-by-step in the ticket.
Marta C: quick FYI — account exec will expect an update by EOD Friday. Also flagging renewal opportunity: if pilot goes well they want Dedicated; if it fails we risk churn. Please prioritize.
Tom R: Acknowledged. I'll fast-track logging config and KMS IAM attach.
Sam T: Approved by ops. Rate window will be applied at the scheduled start and auto-reverted at end time. I'll monitor and notify if we hit >70% usage.
Marta C: thanks all :tada: I'll update RidgeView and loop in the account exec once infra confirms.
